lead: Musical instruments and the gear around them, from guitars, keyboards, drums and orchestral and world instruments to amps, pedals, studio and DJ equipment, organised by instrument family and then by maker or tradition archetype.

depts.note: Kind → maker archetype (Stratocaster, Les Paul, D-28…) → era/reissue → finish and spec.

b.v: neck profile, fret condition, action, intonation
b.w: Weighed first by players and guitar techs.

b.v: laminate → solid top → all-solid; bolt-on → set → neck-through
b.w: Standard axis in maker catalogues and acoustic reviews.

b.v: single-coil, P-90, humbucker; passive or active
b.w: Defines the voice of an electric.

b.v: import → national → custom shop; pre-CBS, Norlin and similar eras
b.w: How collectors and the vintage trade value guitars.

s.brief: Organise by archetype, ordered by significance, with maker register names: Fender Stratocaster, Telecaster, Jazzmaster, Jaguar; Gibson Les Paul, SG, Flying V, Explorer, Firebird; PRS Custom 24; Ibanez superstrats (RG, Jem); Gretsch 6120/White Falcon; Rickenbacker 330/360; Gibson ES-335, ES-175, L-5, Super 400; Epiphone Casino. Versions = eras/reissues (pre-CBS, '57/'59 reissues, Custom Shop). Turn the generic S-type/T-type/single-cut entries into types or maker-free archetypes. Brand register: Fender, Gibson, Gretsch, Rickenbacker, PRS, Ibanez, ESP, Jackson, Epiphone, Squier, Yamaha, Schecter, Danelectro and other notable makers (stubs for the tail).

k.brief: ES-335 family, Rickenbacker 330, Gretsch Electromatic semis
Archtop jazz boxes: ES-175, L-5, Super 400, Gretsch 6120, Epiphone Casino; include luthier archtops (D'Angelico, Benedetto)

s.brief: Archetypes: Martin D-28, D-18, 000-18, OM; Gibson J-45, Hummingbird, Dove, J-200; Taylor 814ce/Grand Auditorium; Guild D-55; Ovation Balladeer; Lowden; classical archetypes (Torres pattern, Hauser, Ramírez 1a, flamenco blanca/negra); resonator archetypes (National tricone, Style O, Dobro). Body shapes (dreadnought, OM, jumbo, parlour) and 12-string are types. Brand register entries for Martin, Taylor, Gibson acoustics, Guild, Yamaha, Takamine, Ramírez, Cordoba, National, Dobro.

Archetypes: Fender Precision Bass, Jazz Bass; Music Man StingRay; Rickenbacker 4001/4003; Höfner 500/1 violin bass; Gibson Thunderbird, EB-0/EB-3; Warwick Thumb; Alembic; extended-range basses as types (5-, 6-string, fretless). Convert P-type/J-type to types. Add acoustic bass guitar as a new kind.

depts.note: Parts owners swap and upgrade; strings live here too.

s.brief: Archetypes: PAF humbucker (Seymour Duncan '59, Gibson Burstbucker), Fender-style single-coil, P-90, Filter'Tron, EMG 81/85 actives; Floyd Rose locking tremolo, Bigsby vibrato, Tune-o-matic, vintage synchronised tremolo; Kluson and Grover tuners, locking tuners; Warmoth/Allparts necks and bodies. Strings: collapse the four guitar-string kinds into one kind with types (electric, acoustic phosphor-bronze/80-20, classical nylon/fluorocarbon, gauges, coatings) and archetype lines (Ernie Ball Slinky, D'Addario EXL, Elixir Nanoweb); bass strings separate. Only what owners actually swap.

depts.note: Variety for acoustic pianos, vintage keys and synths; tier for digital pianos and controllers.

b.w: Main buying axis in piano and keyboard reviews.
How synth and digital piano reviews compare instruments.

s.brief: Split acoustic piano into grand and upright. Maker archetypes: Steinway Model D/B/O/M/S, Steinway K-52 upright; Bösendorfer Imperial 290; Fazioli F278; Bechstein; Blüthner; Yamaha CFX, C3, U1/U3, b1; Kawai SK/K series; Shigeru Kawai; Steingraeber; Pleyel and Érard (historical). Electric pianos: Fender Rhodes Mark I/II, Wurlitzer 200A, Hohner Clavinet D6, Yamaha CP-70/80. Digital pianos tier: Yamaha Clavinova, Roland, Kawai, Casio. Harpsichord national schools (Flemish/Ruckers, French, Italian) become archetypes; add clavichord and player piano.

k.brief: old Yamaha b1/U1 and Kawai K 15 models go to the right kind
stage piano as type; tier-mode models

s.brief: Archetypes: Hammond B-3, C-3, A-100, M-3; Leslie 122/147; combo organs Vox Continental, Farfisa Compact; Lowrey and home spinet organs; modern clones (Nord Electro/C2D, Hammond SKX) as versions; house and chamber pipe organs kind-level only.

k.brief: combo and home organs as types
chamber/house organs only; no church installations

s.brief: Split synthesizer into monophonic and polyphonic. Archetypes ordered by significance: Moog Minimoog Model D, Korg MS-20, Roland TB-303 (bass synth), ARP Odyssey, ARP 2600, Roland SH-101, Sequential Prophet-5, Roland Juno-60/106, Jupiter-8, Yamaha DX7, Oberheim OB-X, Korg M1, Access Virus, Nord Lead; versions = reissues and clones (Behringer, Korg/ARP). Modular: Moog modular, Buchla 100/200, Eurorack (Doepfer A-100 founding format); add a Eurorack maker register (Make Noise, Mutable Instruments, Intellijel, Doepfer…) as brand entries. Theremin archetypes: RCA, Moog Etherwave. Old MiniFreak/Osmose/Muse models go to the right kind.

Archetypes: Roland TR-808, TR-909, TR-606, CR-78; Linn LM-1/LinnDrum; E-mu SP-1200; Akai MPC60/MPC2000 lineage; Ensoniq/E-mu Emulator and Fairlight (historical samplers); Roland SP-404 lineage; Elektron Machinedrum/Octatrack/Digitakt; Teenage Engineering OP-1/OP-Z; Korg Volca; Novation Circuit. Clones and reissues (Behringer RD-8/RD-78, Roland TR-8S) as versions. Trim SKU duplication (P-6 listed twice).
Restraint: trim to market-covering brands (Arturia, Novation, Akai, Native Instruments, Roland, Korg) and test winners; fix model names to include maker; wind controller types (EWI, Aerophone).

b.v: maple, birch, mahogany, steel, brass; B20 vs B8 bronze
b.w: Main axis in drum and cymbal catalogues.

s.brief: Archetypes: Ludwig Classic Maple/Vistalite, Ludwig Supraphonic 400 and Black Beauty snares, Gretsch USA Custom ('That Great Gretsch Sound'), Rogers Holiday/Dynasonic, Slingerland Radio King, DW Collector's, Pearl Masters/Export, Tama Starclassic/Imperialstar, Yamaha Recording Custom, Sonor; e-kits Roland V-Drums (TD series), Alesis, Yamaha DTX. Percussion pads archetype Roland Octapad.

Cymbal-making traditions (Turkish/Istanbul hand-hammered, Zildjian, Chinese China-type) as tradition entries; archetype lines: Zildjian K, A, K Constantinople; Paiste 2002, Signature, 602; Sabian AA/HH; Istanbul Agop, Bosphorus; Meinl Byzance. Sizes/weights as types. Add effects/stack cymbal kind.

Add the expected world drums with traditions (West African djembe, Afro-Cuban congas/bongos, Hindustani tabla, Middle Eastern darbuka, frame drums: bodhrán, riq, tar). Archetypes: LP (Latin Percussion) congas, PANArt Hang (handpan origin), Hugh Tracey kalimba, Zimbabwean mbira. Trim cajon SKU list to a few makers (Schlagwerk, LP, Meinl, De Gregorio) with Peruvian cajón tradition. Singing bowls: Himalayan tradition.
Makers: Marimba One, Yamaha, Adams, Musser, Deagan (vintage); Musser M55 vibraphone, Deagan; Ludwig/Dresden-pattern timpani. Add glockenspiel.

depts.note: Kind → maker/school archetype (Stradivari pattern, Selmer Mark VI, Bach Stradivarius) → version → detail.

b.w: Standard ladder used by band-instrument makers and teachers.
Drives value for string instruments and vintage horns.

s.brief: Archetypes: Stradivari and Guarneri del Gesù patterns (most modern violins copy them), Amati; schools as traditions (Cremonese, Mittenwald, French Mirecourt, Markneukirchen); modern makers (Yamaha, Eastman, Gliga) tier at student level. Bows as a new kind: Tourte model, pernambuco vs carbon (CodaBow).
Makers: Haynes, Powell, Muramatsu, Miyazawa, Yamaha, Pearl; recorder archetypes by historical model (Rottenburgh, Bressan, Denner, Ganassi) with makers Moeck, Mollenhauer, Küng, Yamaha, Aulos.

Merge B-flat and C clarinet into one clarinet kind with types (B♭, A, C, E♭). Archetypes: Buffet Crampon R13, RC, Tosca; Selmer; Yamaha CSG; Boehm vs Oehler system as types. Oboe: Lorée, Marigaux; bassoon: Heckel, Fox. Add cor anglais. Trim bass-clarinet SKU list.

Archetypes: Selmer Mark VI, Balanced Action, Super Action 80 Series II, Reference 54; Conn 10M 'Naked Lady', Conn 6M; King Super 20; Yanagisawa 901/902/992; Yamaha YAS-62/82Z; Keilwerth SX90R. Trim baritone 16-model list. Mouthpieces (Otto Link, Meyer) noted as a type or left to accessories.

Archetypes: Bach Stradivarius 180S37 trumpet, Bach 42 trombone, Conn 8D French horn, Holton, King 3B, Yamaha Xeno, Besson Sovereign/Prestige euphonium and cornet, Getzen, Schilke, Alexander 103 horn; Miraphone/Meinl Weston tubas. Add cornet. Fix maker on euphonium/flugelhorn models.

depts.note: Kind → tradition or maker archetype; craft traditions in the traditions register.

b.w: How players and museums classify folk instruments.

s.brief: Archetypes: Martin and Kamaka ukuleles (soprano/concert/tenor/baritone as types); Gibson Mastertone banjo, Vega; Gibson F-5 Lloyd Loar mandolin; Greek bouzouki vs Irish bouzouki; oud schools (Arabic, Turkish, Syrian) as types/traditions; sitar Ravi Shankar vs Vilayat Khan style, makers Hiren Roy, Rikhi Ram; Saraswati veena; Tsugaru shamisen. Add balalaika, pipa, charango. Trim oud SKUs.

Harp: pedal harp (Lyon & Healy Style 23, Salvi), lever/Celtic harp (Camac, Dusty Strings). Zithers: koto, guzheng, kantele, Appalachian dulcimer, hammered dulcimer/santur. Bowed: erhu, sarangi, taus/dilruba, kokyu, Hardanger fiddle, nyckelharpa. Traditions entries for each.

Dissolve 'Other accordions' into button accordion (melodeon, chromatic button, Cajun as types) and 'Other harmonicas' into diatonic harmonica (tremolo, octave as types). Archetypes: Hohner Marine Band 1896, Special 20, Chromonica 270; Hohner Morino, Castelfidardo makers (Paolo Soprani, Scandalli); Alfred Arnold bandoneon; Wheatstone/Lachenal concertinas; Indian hand harmonium. Add bandoneon.

Bagpipe traditions (Great Highland, uilleann, smallpipes, border, gaita, musette) as archetypes/traditions. Add tin whistle (Clarke, Generation), shakuhachi, bansuri, ney, pan flute, ocarina, didgeridoo. Hichiriki stays (gagaku tradition).

Archetypes: Swiss cylinder music box (Reuge), disc music boxes (Regina, Polyphon); street barrel organ; Sandvik musical saw; Franklin glass armonica (Finkenbeiner). Period is an attribute, not a kind.

depts.note: Amps by archetype circuit (Twin, Plexi, AC30); pedals by circuit archetype (Tube Screamer, Klon, Big Muff…).

b.w: Main axis of amp and pedal reviews.

s.brief: Archetypes: Fender Twin Reverb, Deluxe Reverb, Bassman 5F6-A, Champ; Marshall JTM45, 1959 Super Lead 'Plexi', JCM800 2203; Vox AC30; Mesa/Boogie Mark series and Dual Rectifier; Dumble Overdrive Special; Peavey 5150; Ampeg SVT and B-15 (bass); Roland JC-120; Orange OR120. Cabinets: Marshall 1960 4x12. Speakers: Celestion Greenback, Vintage 30, Jensen P10R. Modellers: Line 6 POD, Fractal Axe-FX, Kemper, Neural DSP Quad Cortex; trim the 29-model modeller list. Add guitar speaker and attenuator kinds.

Circuit archetypes with originator and clones as versions: Ibanez TS808/TS9 Tube Screamer, Klon Centaur, Boss OD-1, BD-2 Blues Driver, Marshall Guv'nor; ProCo RAT, Boss DS-1, MXR Distortion+; Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi (versions: triangle, ram's head, Russian), Arbiter Fuzz Face, Sola Sound Tone Bender, Maestro FZ-1 Fuzz-Tone; Dallas Rangemaster treble booster, MXR Micro Amp, Electro-Harmonix LPB-1. Brand register for pedal makers (Boss, Electro-Harmonix, MXR/Dunlop, Ibanez, JHS, Strymon, Fulltone, Keeley…).

Archetypes: Maestro Echoplex and Roland RE-201 Space Echo (tape), Boss DM-2, Electro-Harmonix Memory Man, Boss DD-3, Strymon TimeLine; Boss CE-1/CE-2 chorus; Electro-Harmonix Electric Mistress, MXR M117 flanger; MXR Phase 90, Electro-Harmonix Small Stone; Shin-ei Uni-Vibe; Fender spring reverb tank; Strymon BigSky, Electro-Harmonix Holy Grail. Add vibe and octave/ring-mod kinds only if sourced.

Archetypes: Vox Clyde McCoy wah / Dunlop Cry Baby GCB95; DigiTech Whammy; Ross/MXR Dyna Comp compressor; Boss GE-7; Boss RC loopers, Electro-Harmonix 720; Eventide H9/H90; Line 6 Helix as multi-effects. Ernie Ball volume pedal.

depts.note: Home-studio and small-band gear; tier except for classic microphones.

b.v: home recording → project studio → live band
b.w: Matches how shops and test sites group this gear.

s.brief: Archetypes: Shure SM57, SM58, SM7B, Unidyne 55; Electro-Voice RE20; Sennheiser MD 421, MD 441; Neumann U 47, U 67, U 87, KM 84/184; AKG C12, C414; Coles 4038; Royer R-121; RCA 44/77 ribbons; Beyerdynamic M 160. Clones (Warm Audio WA47/WA87) as versions. Wireless systems tier only.

Restraint: trim the 31-model mixer list and DI list to market-covering brands (Allen & Heath, Behringer, Mackie, Yamaha, Soundcraft; Radial for DI) and test winners; interface tier (Focusrite, Universal Audio, Audient, MOTU, SSL).
Restraint: trim PA speaker list (24) to market-covering brands (JBL, QSC, Electro-Voice, Yamaha, RCF, Mackie, Bose) and test winners; studio monitors tier (Genelec, Adam, Yamaha HS, KRK, Neumann).

Restraint: studio headphones tier (Sennheiser, Beyerdynamic, Audio-Technica, Sony MDR-7506); merge-check in-ear monitors vs in-ear monitor system (earpieces vs wireless system) and keep both if distinct.

b.w: How DJs and DJ retailers split the market.

s.brief: Archetypes: Technics SL-1200 (MK2 → MK7, SL-1210GR) with clones as maker-free archetype; Pioneer DJ CDJ series (CDJ-500 → CDJ-3000) and DJM mixers (DJM-900NXS2, DJM-A9); Rane rotary mixers and Allen & Heath Xone; Vestax PMC-05; Ortofon Concorde and Shure M44-7 cartridges; standalone all-in-ones (XDJ-RX, Denon Prime). Trim controller list (19).

b.v: gig bag → hard case → flight case
b.w: Shop and test-site axis for accessories.

s.brief: Tier: guitar cases (Gator, Mono, Hiscox, SKB), music stands (Manhasset, K&M), instrument stands (Hercules, K&M), pedalboards (Pedaltrain), drum hardware (DW 5000 pedal archetype, Tama Iron Cobra, Yamaha, Pearl Eliminator). Plain definitions; few models.
Tier: drumsticks (Vic Firth 5A, Promark, Vater), plectrums (Dunlop Tortex, Jazz III; Fender 351 shape), capos (Kyser, Shubb, G7th), reeds (Vandoren, D'Addario Rico), rosin, instrument cables.
Restraint: trim tuner list (17) and metronomes to market-covering brands (Boss, Korg, TC Electronic, Peterson, Snark; Seiko, Wittner) and test winners; practice mute types.
